definitions.explanation: Steamed white rice, the staple food of Japan.
Food in general, or a meal.

notes:
ごはん is one of the most important words in Japanese, meaning both "cooked rice" and "meal."

KANJI:
Written as ご{飯|はん} with kanji. The ご is an honorific prefix.

MEAL NAMES:
- {朝|あさ}ごはん: breakfast
- {昼|ひる}ごはん: lunch
- {晩|ばん}ごはん/{夜|よる}ごはん: dinner

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ごはんを{食|た}べる: to eat (a meal)
- ごはんを{炊|た}く: to cook rice
- ごはんの{時間|じかん}: mealtime
- ごはんのおかわり: another serving of rice

CULTURE:
Rice is so central to Japanese cuisine that ごはん came to mean "meal" in general. Asking ごはん{食|た}べた? means "Have you eaten?" regardless of what was actually eaten.
